result:
**Root cause:** `pieceValSigned` in `variants/bug04/engine.inc` had its colour test inverted (`ret nz` where the piece-code black bit needs `ret z`), so the white-relative material+piece-square term `pstScore` — and with it the entire non-king material component of `eval` — carried the wrong sign.

**Files touched**
- `variants/bug04/engine.inc` — the fix: `ret nz` → `ret z` in `pieceValSigned` (one code byte, `0xC0`→`0xC8`, length-preserving), plus two clarifying comments.
- `variants/bug04/eval_sign_test.py` — new regression test, 5 cases.
- `variants/bug04/Makefile` — `make test` now runs that test as its final step.
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — write-up and working state.

**Gate status**
- Reported symptom no longer reproduces — PASS. Pos 1: `e6d5` at depth 2 (+953) and depth 3 (+1003); pos 2: `b3a1`, material −320 (`Matl -3`); pos 3: score `−1786`, the report's expected number exactly.
- `make test` — PASS, 6/6 (golden board, 1.e4 reply, perft, save/load, 128K banked TT, eval sign), ~22 s.
- New test — PASS, 5 ok / 0 failed on the fixed tape; proven red 0 ok / 5 failed on the preserved pre-fix tape, and `make test` itself aborts with `Error 1` on that tape while all five pre-existing steps pass, so this is the only check in the suite that catches the bug.
- Characterisation (57 cases, recorded from pristine) — PASS, 57 ok / 0 failed / exit 0. It was 53/4 before the fix; the four red cases were `se_recapture`, `se_win_material`, `se_pawn_up`, `se_knight_up`, all in the `search` group, and no other case moved.
- Review — PASS. One synchronous round, verdict `NO DEFECT IN THE FIX`, gate closed at round 1 of a permitted 3. The reviewer independently rebuilt from source (byte-identical), traced the changed byte to code address `0x953B`, audited all six call sites and every colour test in the eval, and probed the characterisation blind spots (en passant, promotion, depth 4, hanging bishop, a four-move opening, Kiwipete d3) without finding a defect.

**Knowingly left open**
- Three of the reviewer's six non-blocking observations were resolved post-review (two factual corrections in `FIX_NOTES.md`, plus hardening my own test so a frame-starved run cannot pass on a half-finished score); the engine fix is byte-identical to what was reviewed, and all gates were re-run green afterwards. The remaining three are recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md` §6 and not closed: the pristine tape lives outside this workspace so "restores pristine behaviour" rests on the 57 recorded observations plus direct probes rather than a byte-diff; the characterisation suite's declared blind spots (position editor, opening book, 128K beyond three cases, depths > 3, long games, clocks) remain unpinned — and note that `se_reply_d1/d2/d3` stay green even on the buggy build because the opening book answers 1.e4, so only 4 of its 9 `search` cases actually pin the evaluation; and `make test` uses relative paths so it must be run from the variant directory, a pre-existing pattern I did not change.

One operational note: `characterisation/characterise.py`'s default `--harness` path points outside this workspace, so it must be run as `python3 characterise.py --harness ../harness --tap ../variants/bug04/chess.tap`.
